name: Chicken Hawaiian
recipeIngredient: 1 can (14 oz/398 mL) pineapple tidbits with juice

recipeInstructions.text: Combine rice, chicken broth, and contents of Bake 'N Shake pouch as directed on the package.
Arrange chicken breasts in a single layer in a 9x13 inch (2.5 L) casserole dish.
Coat chicken with a mixture of ground ginger and garlic.
Top chicken with pineapple tidbits and juice.
Sprinkle the prepared rice mixture over the chicken.

keywords: Hawaiian chicken, pineapple chicken, baked chicken and rice
